snippet.title: 【DIGIMON UP】 Teaser Trailer - Pre‑registration Launch Ver.
snippet.description:
Pre-register here!
https://bnent.jp/Digimon_PrePVEN/

Pre-registration is now open for the brand-new Digimon mobile game, DIGIMON UP!
Reach 100,000 preregistrations to get Gekkomon!

A highly anticipated new entry in the Digimon series, built around the concept:
“A Digimon journey that moves with your life.”

This game even comes with brand new pixel art,
and you'll encounter lots of familiar Digimon components when playing!


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
▼Official website
https://dgup.bn-ent.net/en/

▼Official X
https://x.com/Digimon_up_en

▼Official Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/digimon.up.en/
